About the role
Victoria 3 is our grand strategy game about building a society through the 19th and early 20th centuries, from its economy and trade to its politics and the lives of its people. Our players debate tariffs, trade routes and voting reform with a passion few genres see, and we want someone who enjoys being in the middle of those conversations.
As Community Manager for Victoria 3, you are the voice of the game in the community and the voice of our players inside the team. You take part in discussions on the Paradox Forum and social media, front our streams and community activities, and make sure what players tell us reaches the people who make the game.
You work inside the Victoria 3 team at Paradox Development Studio Red, next to the designers, producers and developers who build the game. That puts you close to the decisions and gives you a direct role in shaping where the game goes next.
What you will do
Own the Victoria 3 Community Plan: set targets for reach, engagement and sentiment, and grow a healthy, inclusive community around the game.

Run all owned Victoria 3 channels, including the Paradox Forum, X, YouTube, Facebook and Instagram, as the voice of the brand.

Plan the content calendar and make sure dev diaries, announcements and patch notes go out on time.

Write copy for patch notes, campaign pages and other brand communication.

Turn community feedback into input the design and development teams can act on, and tell players what we did with it.

Measure how your content and campaigns perform, and report on reach, engagement and community sentiment to the team and our partners.

Coordinate announcements and campaigns with marketing, PR, partner management and performance marketing.

Lead the freelance Community Ambassadors who help you moderate and run the channels.

Take part in live streams, events and other community activities as one of the faces of Victoria 3.

What we are looking for
Experience building and nurturing audiences on social media, and creating engaging content for a consumer audience.

Strong copywriting and content creation skills.

Excellent proactive and reactive communication: you can plan a campaign and handle a heated thread with the same calm.

A deep understanding of and interest in video game culture and communities.

The ability to turn player feedback and channel data into clear conclusions.

Fluency in written and spoken English.

Nice to have
Experience playing Victoria 3 or other Paradox grand strategy games.

An interest in history, economics or politics.

Basic skills in Photoshop and video editing tools.

Practical information
Scope: Full time and permanent

Reports to: Studio Manager, Paradox Development Studio Red

Location: Stockholm, Sweden

Working at Paradox
At Paradox you join a result-driven, high-trust and player-centric culture. Our games and players take center stage, and our first priority is always to add player value. If you thrive on the opportunities this culture brings and know how to handle the challenges that come with it, we encourage you to apply and join our team.

The opportunity
Would you like to join our excellent team of Sub-Project Managers in HVDC System Engineering organization and have an impact on the goals and future business opportunities?
Then you may become one of our great colleagues and take on responsibility in a stimulating work environment. Together with the team you will work in cross-functional project groups to design and develop
HVDC systems. Working with us will offer you to grow your network internationally and open a multitude of career possibilities based on your interests and ambitions.
We are interested in learning more about you and what you can contribute with so don’t hesitate to apply even though you don’t meet all requirements.
How you´ll make an impact
Supporting projects and tenders for HVDC System Design - managing the scope, budget and schedule while ensuring quality requirements are met.
Be ready to be proactive and apply your project management and analytical skills.
Interface with other departments in HVDC organization, representing your System Design team in project and tender meetings and discussions, also representing System Design in customer meetings.
Participate in technical design reviews and in technical problem solving.
Responsible for the technical coordination of System Design deliveries as well as managing the risks and identifying opportunities to reduce time and cost while ensuring quality requirements are met.
When you feel comfortable in the role you get the opportunity to manage complex projects on your own. In other words, your ambition is the foundation for your development opportunities!
Living Hitachi Energy’s Leadership Pillars as a leader which means live our vision, work together, deliver promises, and develop people.

Your background
You hold a Master’s or Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering preferably in Electric Power Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
HVDC system design knowledge is considered an asset.
You have good communication- and interpersonal skills.
You enjoy working in diverse and multicultural teams and are interested to share your experiences and knowledge with your colleagues as well as learn from them.
You are a flexible leader that enjoy problem solving and work in a structured way.
Fluency in English, additional languages are considered an asset.
Preferably, you have project management experience from working in engineering and are familiar with managing system delivery projects or tenders. HVDC system design project management experience is considered an asset.

Additional Information
Are you ready for an exciting new challenge? Does the above description sound like you? Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so don’t delay – apply today!

and it is used to transmit power reliably and efficiently over long distances and with minimal losses, using overhead lines, underground and submarine cable systems

Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team   About this opportunityEricsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward.
 The Excellerate track is designed to develop future leaders who are motivated by performance, pace, and commercial impact. You’ll rotate across Sales, Commercial Management, Strategy, Supply, Finance and more. Working on priorities that directly influence results and learning how different parts of the business connect to create value.
 This isn’t a programme where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here.Your journey within the Excellerate Program will start as a Commercial Contract Manager in Business Area Networks Sales & Commercial Management!
 What you will do In this role, you will work together with a team of experienced, senior Contract Managers to handle complex and key contractual questions about the Networks Portfolio. In addition, you will contribute to the implementation of the Global Sales and Networks Contracting strategy, being part of shaping the future of contracting at Ericsson. You will also have the opportunity to engage in selected high-priority deals as a Business Area Contract Manager and ensure that lessons learned are captured and reused to evolve our contracting strategy. And as a member of the Sales Operations & Contract Management team, you will support and participate in strengthening the Contract Management community across Ericsson, including how we build competence and awareness across the wider organization.
 You will bring Joining the team will offer you an exciting journey through business and technology where you will learn, be able to challenge, take decisions and most importantly have a lot of fun! We believe you can challenge us in who we're looking for and believe you have an interest for business and commerical contract management combined with a technical interest in the telecommunications industry. 
 In addition, we believe you have:
  A master’s degree in Law, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering & Management, or equivalent.
 Experience in Contract Management, Law or Project Management. Sales and Commerical roles can also be a relevant background.
 Strong analytics skills, ability to extract relevant information from large source material.
 Communication and stakeholder management skills.
 Understanding and awareness of Telecoms & Technology sectors and the role of Contracts in business.
 A global attitude and willingness to relocate internationally, with a desire and ability to work in a multicultural environment.
 Keen interest to learn new things and to broaden experience.
 Ability to collaborate, engage with and mobilize the organization to secure results.
 Solid presentation and communication skills, and proficiency in English.
  
We can promise you a steep learning curve, exciting tasks and close collaboration as a valued member of a strategically important team. Be the one who did.

A Snapshot of Your Day
In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining and publishing machine, spare parts, and partner data in Energy Shop, ensuring high data quality and timely availability for users worldwide. You will act as the primary point of contact for Energy Shop-related questions, supporting internal stakeholders across different functions and helping them get the most value from the platform.
Your day will also involve supporting the testing, validation, and implementation of new features and enhancements, while monitoring and reporting on key performance indicators to drive continuous improvement.
 
How you’ll make a difference
Extract, validate, and manage data from source systems (including SAP).
Drive Energy Shop improvements by gathering requirements, prioritizing feedback, and collaborating with development teams.
Identify and resolve data quality issues, manage backlogs, and coordinate corrective actions.
Improve data quality, process efficiency, automation, and AI-supported workflows.
Collaborate across functions to improve data flows, standardize processes, and strengthen data governance.

What you bring
Experience with spare parts catalogs, product information systems, or e-commerce platforms.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
Strong knowledge of master data management, data governance, and data quality principles.
Experience with SAP and managing large datasets.
Experience with requirements gathering, process improvement, or digital platform development is an advantage.
Proficiency in Excel; Power BI or similar analytical tools are a plus.
Knowledge of rotating equipment, gas turbines, or industrial service operations is beneficial.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Able to work independently, take ownership, and collaborate effectively in a global environment.
Fluent in English.

 
 
Who is Siemens Energy?
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With +100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. 
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. 
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
 
Our Commitment to Diversity
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
 
Application
Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , id nr 306185 not later than 2026-11-15
Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date.
We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking an experienced, hands-on Integration Specialist to support business-critical HR IT solutions within a complex enterprise environment. The assignment combines the development of new integrations, modernization of existing interfaces, and technical troubleshooting across an integration platform built on PostgreSQL.
The platform facilitates the exchange and transformation of employee, organizational, and other HR-related data between core HR systems and downstream applications covering payroll, time management, benefits, expense management, and analytics. The Integration Specialist will own solutions throughout the complete lifecycle, from technical analysis and design through implementation, testing, deployment, operational handover, and production maintenance.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, configure, and maintain enterprise integration solutions.
Translate functional requirements, field mappings, and business rules into technical implementations using PostgreSQL, SQL, Web APIs, web services, and file-based interfaces.
Implement data mapping, transformation, validation, filtering, routing logic, and reference data handling.
Analyze existing interfaces, data flows, system dependencies, and integration behavior.
Conduct integration testing, defect analysis, debugging, and technical troubleshooting.
Maintain and troubleshoot integrations operating in production environments.
Improve integration performance, reliability, maintainability, monitoring, and data quality.
Prepare technical documentation and support deployments and operational handovers.
Apply secure integration practices related to data protection, access controls, error handling, and operational monitoring.
Independently drive technical delivery while collaborating with developers, solution architects, service managers, system owners, and business stakeholders.
Identify technical risks, dependencies, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

Technical Stack & Requirements
Database and query technologies: Strong practical experience with PostgreSQL and SQL development.
Integration interfaces: Experience designing and implementing enterprise integrations through Web APIs, web services, and file-based interfaces such as SFTP.
Data formats: Practical experience working with structured formats including JSON and XML.
Integration engineering: Sound understanding of integration architecture, technical design, data mapping, transformations, validations, filtering, routing, and business-rule implementation.
Delivery lifecycle: Experience with integration testing, defect analysis, debugging, deployment, production support, and operational monitoring.
Security: Understanding of secure integration development, data protection, access controls, error handling, and appropriate monitoring.
Advantageous technologies: Experience with SQL-based integration platforms, integration middleware, comparable in-house solutions, JavaScript, or Groovy.
Engineering practices: Experience with Agile development methods, version control, and collaborative software development is advantageous.

Qualifications & Experience
Candidates must have at least three years of professional experience in hands-on integration development or a comparable technical development role. A relevant technical degree or equivalent professional experience is required, together with professional written and spoken English.
Experience with SAP SuccessFactors or other HR master-data integrations is advantageous. Additional merit will be given for experience integrating payroll, benefits, time-management, expense-management, analytics, or other HR applications, as well as knowledge of HR and payroll data structures, employee lifecycle processes, and organizational data dependencies. Swedish language proficiency is also advantageous.
The successful consultant should be capable of independently owning technical assignments from analysis through implementation and operational handover while working effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Are you ready to be the central point of contact for transport and logistics in a groundbreaking industrial project? Do you thrive in managing complex supply flows, optimizing deliveries, and driving green energy forward? Then we have the perfect role for you!
 About the position 
Perido is looking for a Logistics Specialist on behalf of our client, an industrial enterprise driving large-scale initiatives within green energy and manufacturing. The position is located in Boden and involves key responsibility for all transport and logistics matters connected to their construction stream. Your daily tasks
As a Logistics Specialist, you will be the focal point for the supply chain, ensuring seamless and efficient transport of goods from the warehouse to handover with contractors. 
Main responsibilities:
Act as the focal point for all transport and logistics related matters for the movement of goods for a specified construction stream
Responsible for a variety of shipments from the warehouse and handover to contractors
Work in close cooperation with the appointed transport company to monitor, track, and ensure on-time delivery of shipments
Assess carrier performance with respect to set KPIs
Prepare and organize a daily transportation schedule to site
Follow up on deviations, logistics costs, and reporting

Your characteristics
We are looking for someone with excellent interpersonal and communication skills who excels in a dynamic environment with multiple stakeholders. You are a structured problem-solver motivated by optimizing flows and securing high delivery precision. With your collaborative mindset, you build strong relationships with suppliers and contractors on site. 
Is this a challenge you are ready to take on? We look forward to receiving your application – welcome to apply today! 
 Qualifications:
·       3+ years of experience in purchasing, logistics, transport management, or project management
·       Strong knowledge of international logistics operations and distribution systems, including routing, scheduling, and tracking
·       Knowledge of transportation of Out Of Gauge Heavy Haulage Transports
·       Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools and logistics platforms/ERP systems
·       Ability to communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken
Contract type and hours
Full-time, consulting assignment until 2027-06-30. Start 2026-11-09.
Let us help you take the next step in your career
Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations.
 Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/
You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. Please always include the position reference number 36097 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status or disclose the client company if it is not stated in the job advertisement.

We’re looking for a Product Developer RTW to join us on a 12-month parental leave cover. As one of three product developers, you’ll share ownership of the full product lifecycle for RTW across multiple categories, from sourcing and development through fittings, SMS, PPS and into production. Are you hands-on with quality, precise in the details and at your best as part of a team? Come join us.
WHAT YOU WILL DO

Oversee the full RTW product lifecycle from seasonal kick-off to shipment, with a focus on quality, on-time delivery and efficient bulk processes.

Lead fittings and make sure every product meets our quality standards.

Keep the critical path on track, aligning with other departments and suppliers so that all sample rounds and production land on time for key business dates.

Support pre-bookings, drop planning and capacity booking throughout the creation stages.

Keep PLM and internal systems up to date so cross-functional teams have the information they need.

Support supplier sourcing and counter-sourcing strategies together with the Head of Development & Production.

Build and maintain strong relationships with suppliers.

Drive improvements in production delivery, quality and lead times.

ARE YOU THE ONE?
We seek people with most of the following:

A bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.

At least 3 years of experience in RTW product development, with 2 or more of those years within a brand.

A strong understanding of garment construction, techniques and fittings, including complex pieces.

Proficiency in MS Office, Adobe and PLM systems.

An analytical, structured and organized way of working.

A proactive approach to solving problems, with the ability to prioritize and coordinate several things at once.

Curiosity, adaptability and passion for product.

HERE'S HOW TO APPLY
If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.
Please apply by submitting your CV in English. Please do not include a photo or date of birth with your application; our recruitment process is competency-based.
We review applications continuously, and the position may be filled before the closing date.
DETAILS

Contract type: Full-time, 12-month parental leave cover, with the possibility of extension.

Location: Gothenburg HQ

Estimated starting date: January 2027 

Work mode: On-site, travel required

A BIT ABOUT AXEL ARIGATO
Founded in Sweden in 2014 by Albin Johansson and Max Svärdh, Axel Arigato was born with a disruptive mindset, modernising and democratising the sneaker landscape through a blend of style, quality, community and a digital-first approach. Grounded in Scandinavian minimalism and elevated with playful, intentional details, every piece is designed with care: crafted to move globally, worn with individuality. What began online expanded into physical spaces built for energetic cultural exchange: stores and experiences where conversations, performances, and unexpected activations dissolve the boundaries between brand and culture. Today, Axel Arigato continues to evolve with purpose via a people-powered approach. It shows up where culture happens: on streets, at events and across cities.
Built on curiosity. Driven by connection.
OUR VALUES
Diversity, Respect, Openness and Passion are our core values that we live and breathe. They are the foundation for our current state and what we will always bring with us to the future.

Job description
Are you a visionary software architect looking for a challenge that goes beyond standard app development? At Teledyne FLIR in Täby, we build the sensor systems and thermal cameras used globally in fire detection, industrial applications, and blue-light equipment. Now, we need your expertise to shape the brain inside these life-saving products.

We are on a journey to centralize and streamline our Linux-based product offerings into one robust, unified software platform. As our new Embedded Software Architect, you will own the long-term vision, architecture, and roadmap for our Android/AOSP-based platform.
This is a high-impact, strategic, and hands-on role. You will be the technical anchor for our R&D, tasked with balancing urgent product needs with sustainable, scalable, and reusable strategies. You won’t just maintain an architecture; you will define it.

What we offer you
True Autonomy: The mandate to define architectural principles and shape the future of our R&D.
A Collaborative Culture: You will work within a highly skilled, senior team of architects in an environment that values mentorship, continuous learning, and innovation.
Global Impact: The code you architect will run in critical systems used worldwide, making a tangible difference in commercial and government sectors.

Application:
Are you ready to take command of our platform architecture and drive innovation? We look forward to your application. Please note that this role is security-classified, and a security vetting process will be conducted as part of the recruitment. 

Responsibilities
Drive Platform Strategy: Own the long-term architectural vision for our software platform, balancing urgent product needs with sustainable, reusable strategies.
Lead Integration: Facilitate cross-functional synchronization across multiple teams to ensure scale, performance, and security.
Translate Requirements: Collaborate with product management to convert system and business needs into high-level platform technical requirements.
Technical Leadership: Act as the primary spokesperson for the platform area, guiding engineering decisions and fostering a culture of technical excellence.
Drive Modernization: Lead the effort to centralize and streamline our Linux-based product offerings into a robust, unified platform.

Qualifications
We believe you thrive at the intersection of complex software, system engineering, and product development. You are a strategic problem-solver with a proven track record of leading technical decisions and successfully managing multiple product launches.
To succeed in this role, we see that you have:
Deep, hands-on expertise in Android platform architecture, AOSP, and embedded Linux.
A strong background in embedded software development and system integration.
The capacity to influence stakeholders and teams through clear, technical communication.
Fluency in English (professional proficiency in Swedish is a merit).
A relevant academic degree (e.g., M.Sc. in Computer Science/Engineering) OR equivalent deep, practical experience in the field.

About the company

Randstad
På Randstad vet vi att alla människor har en plats på arbetsmarknaden. Med verksamhet över hela landet och inom alla kompetensområden hjälper vi människor att hitta ett jobb som känns bra, och där de får möjlighet att växa, utvecklas och uppnå sin fulla potential. 
Med närmare 600 000 anställda i 38 länder är Randstad världsledande inom HR-tjänster, med målsättningen att bli världens främsta och mest uppskattade partner på arbetsmarknaden. Genom att kombinera vår passion för människor med kraften i dagens teknologi hjälper vi människor och företag att uppnå deras fulla potential. Vi kallar det Human Forward.

About the Role
As a Senior Backend Engineer in the Orders team, you will shape the overall architecture, technical direction, and scalability of our core order-handling engine. The Orders domain is central to Instabee’s operations, processing deliveries for millions of consumers across Europe.
In this role, you’ll take on a high-leverage technical leadership position—driving architectural decisions, integrating modern technologies, and elevating engineering standards across our distributed systems.
Key Responsibilities
Architect Core Systems: Lead the technical design, scalability, and resilience of our high-throughput order backbone.

Integrate AI & Modern Tech: Proactively adopt AI tools, LLMs, and smart automations to boost system capabilities and developer workflows.

Drive Strategy & Mentorship: Partner with product leaders to align tech roadmaps with business goals while coaching junior and mid-level engineers.

Continuous Optimization: Audit, refactor, and evolve our distributed microservices to ensure top-tier reliability and performance.

Collaborative Engineering: Champion technical excellence through high-standard code reviews, mob/pair programming, and shared ownership.

Your Future Team
The Orders team builds and maintains the core engine responsible for the end-to-end order lifecycle—from creation to successful delivery. Supported by an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and Staff Engineer, you will operate with high autonomy in a tight-knit, collaborative environment where your technical decisions carry direct, company-wide impact.
What We’re Looking For
Senior Backend Background: Solid track record of architecting and operating resilient, high-throughput distributed systems in production.

Core Stack: Deep, hands-on expertise in Node.js and TypeScript.

Databases: Advanced experience with MongoDB (or similar NoSQL/relational systems), including query optimization and schema design at scale.

Cloud & Infrastructure: Strong proficiency with Kubernetes and hands-on experience with GCP (or equivalent cloud environments).

AI-Forward Mindset: Practical curiosity for applying AI tooling and developer automations to streamline engineering and operational workflows.

Technical Leadership: Ability to take complex initiatives from concept to production while communicating architectural trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical peers.

Fluency in English: Confident verbal and written communication.

(We value curiosity, problem-solving, and adaptability over ticking every single stack requirement on day one.)
What We Offer
Significant architectural ownership within one of the Nordics' most high-volume logistics platforms.

A culture of technical ambition, continuous learning, and minimal bureaucracy.

A supportive, senior engineering peer group focused on code quality and innovation.

Perks & Benefits:

🏢 Brand-New Office: Modern collaborative workspace in our new Stockholm HQ.

🐶 Dog-Friendly Office: Designated dog-friendly areas throughout the office.

🏓 Fun & Games: Foosball, shuffleboard, table tennis, and an in-house karaoke room.

👶 Parental Top-Up: 6 months of parental pay support.

🎂 Birthday Off: An extra paid day off each year to celebrate your birthday.

⏰ Flexible Hybrid Setup: Flexible working hours tailored to balance life and work.

About Instabee
Formed in 2022 through the merger of Budbee and Instabox (uniting the Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy brands), Instabee provides seamless e-commerce deliveries to millions of consumers. We are growing quickly across the Nordics and continental Europe, building cutting-edge logistics technology that handles millions of parcels each week.
As part of our standard recruitment process in Sweden, mandatory confidential background checks are conducted via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys.

The Opportunity
Join a growing engineering team responsible for the plant electrical design of HVDC converter station projects. Based in Ludvika or Västerås, you will work with plant circuit and cable design, ensuring customer requirements are translated into compliant, high-quality engineering deliverables. Working closely with project teams, suppliers, and technical specialists, you will contribute to the successful delivery of complex projects from design through execution.

You are a self-motivated engineer who takes ownership of your work and enjoys solving technical challenges in collaboration with others. You thrive in a project environment where priorities can shift and where balancing quality, schedule, and technical requirements is essential.

How you’ll make an impact
Develop plant circuit and cable engineering designs for HVDC converter station projects.
Translate customer specifications and contractual requirements into compliant engineering deliverables.
Review and validate technical documentation from suppliers and other stakeholders to ensure technical and contractual compliance.
Apply established design principles, engineering standards, and available base solutions to meet project requirements.
Collaborate with project managers, engineers, suppliers, and technical specialists throughout project execution.
Identify and resolve technical issues, risks, and design deviations that may impact project delivery.
Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering methods, tools, and design documentation.

Your Background
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (electrical, mechanical, industrial, computer science) or a related technical field.
Proven experience in a technical engineering role, preferably within a project-based environment.
Ability to collaborate effectively with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.
Strong communication skills and professional proficiency in English.
A structured and proactive approach with a focus on quality, accuracy, and delivery.
Experience from the energy sector, power systems, HVDC, or other related industries is highly valued.
